author: 0xrubo
content: we finally integrated these benchmarks.  also, found and fixed a few bugs. nethermind now runs the full suite, about 6,000 worst-case blocks from 30m to 200m gas, on zisk. every block matches the spec's expected output. cost scales linearly with gas, the costliest 200m block, kzg point evaluation, comes to about 1.18t in zisk's cost model (9.5g steps). the most steps any block takes is 11.3g.
